name: Bundle of Rays
governedBy: DESIGN.md — authoritative. Values copied, not reinterpreted.

licence.detail: The mark is Jean Jullien's artwork 'Us'. Permission on record (Studio Jean Jullien, 02 Jun 2025) covers The Just Us Show only — 'limited to this project only', no fee, no ongoing use. The wordmark lockup is an ungranted derivative. A written licence for company identity is required before application. See BRAND.md.

paper.role: Page ground. Cool, not warm cream.

rule.note: Faint on uncoated stock with dot gain. Intentional per DESIGN.md; flagged, not overridden.

muted.warning: DESIGN.md assigns this to captions and source lines but also sets a 7:1 body floor. It does not meet it. Use mutedText for those.

mutedText.why: Meets the 7:1 floor for captions and source lines.

accentDark.why: accent is 2.07 on ink and cannot sit on it.

clinicalState.comment: ONLY where the artefact depicts genuine clinical state. Never brand colour, never accent, never decoration.

caution.warning: Do not set type in this value.

retired.comment: The v0.1 four-flat palette. Removed, and it does not come back: Ray was amber, Pulse red, Breath green — the three colours DESIGN.md reserves for clinical state. Using them as brand colour is a category error in a clinical setting.

type.note: Both faces are SIL OFL 1.1 and may be embedded in Unity and Unreal builds. Commercial foundry EULAs routinely prohibit that for application binaries.

layout.shadowUse: Floating elements only. Never static cards.

blockers: Mark licence does not cover company use.
Logo master artwork does not exist; current asset is a 225x224 raster.
